knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE)
if (!exists(".version")) {
    .version <- package_version("1.0")

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("# GFF file (", as.character(.version), ")", sep="")
```

## Overview

The `gff_file` specification describes the on-disk representation of a GFF file.
This allows more complex objects to portably store a reference to a GFF file, e.g., a [`simple_list`](../simple_list) object of multiple files.

## Object metadata

The `OBJECT` file should contain a `gff_file` property, itself a JSON object with the following properties:

- `version`, a string specifying the version of the `gff_file` format.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("  This should be set to \"", as.character(.version), "\".", sep="")
```
- `format`, a string indicating whether the file uses the `GFF2` or `GFF3` format.
- `indexed`, a boolean indicating whether the GFF file has been indexed.

## Directory structure

### Contents

The directory should contain:

- `OBJECT`, a JSON file as described above.

If `format = "GFF2"` and `indexed = false`, the directory should contain:

- `file.gff2.gz`, a Gzip-compressed GFF2 file.

If `format = "GFF3"` and `indexed = false`, the directory should contain:

- `file.gff3.gz`, a Gzip-compressed GFF3 file.

If `format = "GFF3"` and `indexed = false`, the directory should contain:

- `file.gff2.bgz`, a BGZF-compressed GFF2 file.
- `file.gff2.bgz.tbi`, a Tabix file.

If `format = "GFF3"` and `indexed = false`, the directory should contain:

- `file.gff3.bgz`, a Gzip-compressed GFF3 file.
- `file.gff3.bgz.tbi`, a Tabix file.

### `file.gff2.gz`

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
payload2 <-"The `file.gff2.gz` file should be formatted as described in the [GFF2 specification](http://gmod.org/wiki/GFF2)."
cat(payload2)
```

### `file.gff3.gz`

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
payload3 <-"The `file.gff3.gz` file should be formatted as described in the [GFF3 specification](http://gmod.org/wiki/GFF3)."
cat(payload3)
```

### `file.gff2.bgz`

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(sub("\\.gz", ".bgz", payload2))
```

This file should be compressed using the [blocked GNU Zip format](https://www.htslib.org/doc/bgzip.html).

### `file.gff3.bgz`

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(sub("\\.gz", ".bgz", payload3))
```

This file should be compressed using the [blocked GNU Zip format](https://www.htslib.org/doc/bgzip.html).

### `file.gff2.bgz.tbi`

The `file.gff2.bgz.tbi` file should index into `file.gff2.bgz`, following the [Tabix specification](https://samtools.github.io/hts-specs/tabix.pdf).

### `file.gff3.bgz.tbi`

The `file.gff3.bgz.tbi` file should index into `file.gff3.bgz`, following the [Tabix specification](https://samtools.github.io/hts-specs/tabix.pdf).
